name: CheckMK
description: Supervise a remote CheckMK instance from the Omarchy bar: active alerts count, detailed problem panel, acknowledge and refresh actions.
author: OverStyleFR

barWidget.description: Remote CheckMK supervision widget with alert counter, grouped problem list and acknowledge action.

schema.label: CheckMK base URL
schema.description: Base URL of the CheckMK site, e.g. https://checkmk.example.com/monitoring. The API path /check_mk/api/<apiVersion> is appended automatically.

schema.label: API version
schema.description: CheckMK REST API version segment used in the URL.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often the CheckMK problems are polled.

schema.label: Show acknowledged problems
schema.description: Include host/service problems that have already been acknowledged.

schema.label: Max items in panel
schema.description: Maximum number of problems to display in the popup panel.

schema.label: Use host alerts
schema.description: Include host DOWN / UNREACHABLE states in the counter and panel.

schema.label: Use service alerts
schema.description: Include service CRITICAL / WARNING / UNKNOWN states in the counter and panel.

schema.label: Acknowledge comment
schema.description: Default comment used when acknowledging a problem from the panel.
